title: The Builder's Room (Technovation × Women Techmakers) — Tara Chklovski hosts Eric on Incorruptible
summary: Technovation and Google's Women Techmakers program host Eric on The Builder's Room — a virtual conversation with founder Tara Chklovski, with half the questions coming from the Technovation and Women Techmakers communities and half from attendees. Technovation notes Eric gave the keynote at their World Summit 14 years ago and his work shaped the entrepreneurship modules used by 20 years of Technovation builders (25,000 apps and 6,000 AI prototypes to date).
blockquote: Eric coined the term "vanity metrics." He built a career telling founders to stop measuring what looks good and start measuring what's real. Technovation builders have always worked that way. His new book, Incorruptible, distills two decades of research into why organizations drift from their mission and what it takes to build one that doesn't.
attribution_title: The Builder's Room virtual conversation, Wednesday August 19 · 9:00–10:00 AM PDT
